description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Netic is hiring new graduate Full-Stack Software Engineers for its core product team. The role builds and ships full-stack features for Netic’s AI platform, working with customers and owning delivery from specification through production and iteration.
New-Grad Full-Stack Software Engineer building agentic AI platform features across data models, APIs, user interfaces, and production reliability

Responsibilities:
• Build agentic products: Design, code, and ship full-stack features for Netic's AI platform
• Co‑create with customers: Work closely with our customers to understand workflows, gather feedback, and turn pain points into features that stick
• Own end‑to‑end delivery: Drive projects from spec to production, handling data models, APIs, front‑end polish, and post‑launch iteration
• Ensure quality: Build, test, and monitor features in production to ensure reliability and performance

Requirements:
• available to start between winter of 2026 and summer of 2027
• Ability to deliver user‑facing software at scale; you've carried features through multiple release cycles
• Comfortable with React, TypeScript, Python; experience with databases and cloud infrastructure
• Track record of translating stakeholder goals into crisp technical specs and delightful products
• You run toward ambiguity, write clean code quickly, and see failures as data for the next sprint
• Able to explain architectural trade‑offs to engineering, and business outcomes to executives

Preferred:
• Hands‑on with LLM APIs, embeddings, or RAG patterns—or hunger to learn fast
